component.name: File Cleaner
component.summary: Find and remove junk files from your home directory

description.p: File Cleaner scans your home directory for junk files and lets you safely remove them. Supports quick scans of common locations, deep scans of your entire home folder, and scanning specific directories.

ul.li: Quick scan for trash, caches, old logs and large downloads
Deep scan for build artefacts, node_modules, __pycache__ and more
Animated magnifying glass (default) or spinner while scanning
Open any found file directly in your file manager
Privileged deletion via polkit — no need to run as root
First-launch prompt to protect important folders
Folders that contain a protected location are no longer offered for deletion
The user Flatpak repository is no longer offered for deletion
Native .o and .a files are no longer offered for deletion, as toolchains and SDKs depend on them
Redesigned start page, results summary and preferences
